scope:
Qualify completed CPU/CUDA facility forecasts using existing independent audits.

Checks both final reservoir fields and well trajectories at common report dates.
Elapsed times on a shared host are observations, not an isolated speedup test.

final_fields.scope:
Compare completed operational forecasts at the final common report endpoint.

Budgets must be supplied before inspecting the reference result. This is a
step-refinement check, not a proof that the finer trajectory is exact.

report_endpoint_trajectory.scope:
Compare actual well rates/BHP and cumulative mass at coarse report endpoints.

Both bundles must independently pass full facility accounting first. This is
step refinement, not a proof that either trajectory is exact or calibrated.
